text:
Lina: I uploaded the latest draft of the launch post: https://drive.re/redwood/launch-v2 — can people scan the benchmark section and hero claim? debating 'median <100ms' vs '95th <250ms' as the lead.
Omar: Looking now. Quick check  are those numbers from Hosted with caching enabled or from Dedicated pools?
Lina: Hosted baseline with caching disabled in the main narrative, Dedicated numbers are in the appendix. Headline options reflect different audiences.
Sofia: Legal note: any p95 claim needs a reproducible methodology and hardware + config list. Also don't use "industry-leading" or unquantified absolutes.
Ben: I'll add the methodology blurb and the exact command used. bench invocation: `bash run_bench.sh --model redwood-pro --seq 2048 --batch 4 --iters 50 --gpu v100 --quant none`
Rae: For GTM, median-led headline resonates better for marketing. But include p95 in the appendix and a short explainer for engineers/prospects.
Sofia: Agreed. Legal will sign off if appendix includes dataset sample, RNG seed, request mix, and kernel flags. @Ben can you include those?
Ben: Yes. I'll paste the harness and a minimal dataset snippet. Harness: https://ci.re/redwood/bench-v2. I'll also link raw logs.
Lina: CTA mapping: webinar registration should feed both the webinar list and a trial nurture flow. Tag new leads with `launch-alpha`. @Marcom-bot can you create routing and 3-day followups?
Marcom-bot: Routing rule created: form -> webinar-list + trial-nurture. Tag attached: `launch-alpha`. Followup cadence: 3 days, 7 days. Confirm to enable.
Lina: Confirmed, enable it. Also need a quick copy OK on the hero quote from the CTO; @Omar can you scrub absolutes?
Omar: Edited the quote to remove absolutes and added a phrase about typical workloads. Updated in doc and approved. :white_check_mark:
Sofia: Legal approves the revised language now that appendix details are promised.
Lina: Thanks. Scheduling final publish window for tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll lock the doc in 20 minutes and drop a preflight checklist. Any last blockers?
Rae: All good from growth. I'll finalize social snippets and the webinar landing funnel.
Ben: Appendix updated: hardware table, full bench command, RNG seed, dataset sample, and link to logs. Added a short note about variance across instance types.
Lina: Perfect. Locking the doc now and sending the readiness checklist. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
